inspiration: A build script packs many sprites and textures into a few large 1024 atlases with a rectangle packer and writes a small index beside each sheet (texture-pack/texture-pack.js): fewer draw calls, and a clean build step for our own art.
Atmosphere by toggle: underground flicker, fog-of-war veil and roof hiding are simple on/off options on the lighting and occlusion code (src/options.c). Cheap mood tools that need no new art.
Roof hiding rule: roofs show unless the player is inside a building. A simple occlusion rule like this is a clean fix for hidden interiors.
Ground items are small 3D models on the floor (README line 14). The README gives a source for the models; we should build our own item models and keep only the idea of drops as small floor models.
A cycling-colour text effect for highlights, at a low target frame rate (src/options.c): one shared text effect for rare drops and chat highlights.
Low-end interlaced mode (README line 36): render only every second scanline as a cheap fallback for weak hardware.
Touch controls: hold to right-click and drag to zoom, with a delay before the menu (README touch options): a clear mobile input pattern.

briefs.label: Cycling highlight text (our label)
briefs.why: A colour-cycling text effect marks rare drops and chat lines; it reads as special without new art. Config and README only; no art viewed.
briefs.keep: colour cycle through a short ramp; low update rate; the effect applies only to highlight text
briefs.change: our own palette ramp; different cadence; add an outline or shadow

briefs.label: Flickering cave lantern (our label)
briefs.why: An underground lighting flicker makes caves feel alive; the option is on by default in the options code. Idea only.
briefs.keep: subtle flicker on light intensity; per-light random phase
briefs.change: our own flicker pattern; different colour temperature; our own light shapes

briefs.label: Fog veil over unexplored rooms (our label)
briefs.why: A fog-of-war veil hides unexplored zones and keeps exploration tense; on by default in the options code. Idea only.
briefs.keep: soft fog edge over unexplored tiles; reveal as the player walks
briefs.change: our own fog colour and edge shape; a different reveal animation; a different fog density

briefs.label: Floor drop model (our label)
briefs.why: Ground items drawn as small 3D models read from a distance and feel physical. README calls them based on a source model set; we build our own.
briefs.keep: small 3D model on the floor with a soft shadow; one model per item family

briefs.label: Interlaced fallback look (our label)
briefs.why: A half-line render mode is a cheap fallback for weak hardware and gives a retro scan look. Idea only; no shader viewed.

briefs.ref: README.md line 36 (F1 interlace mode); src/options.c (interlace option)
